content: EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED: plotly 6.9.0 px.choropleth(locationmode='ISO-3') builds a valid Choropleth figure trace. UN SDG API returns M49 numeric geoAreaCode (not ISO3), so a crosswalk is required: pycountry 26.2.16 pycountry.countries.get(numeric=str(code).zfill(3)).alpha_3 correctly resolves M49/ISO-3166 numeric codes to ISO3 (verified: numeric 036 -> AUS). Note: pycountry does not cover UN M49 regional aggregate codes (e.g. 'Africa', 'LDCs') since those aren't ISO countries - filter the SDG API GeoArea list to only codes that resolve via pycountry to get actual countries.
